stemEn: A picture was provided for an infant with cleft palate, clenched fist, and rocker-bottom feet. Cardiac evaluation revealed PDA and VSD. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: الـclues في المصدر هي clenched fist + rocker-bottom feet مع congenital heart disease؛ هذه الصورة تدعم Trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome).
reasoningEn: The source identifies the combination of clenched fists, rocker-bottom feet and congenital cardiac defects as Edwards syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: Trisomy 13 يرتبط أكثر بmidline defects مثل cleft lip/palate وholoprosencephaly وpolydactyly. VACTERL يحتاج نمطًا مختلفًا من anomalies.
clinicalPearl: Overlapping/clenched fingers and rocker-bottom feet are classic board clues for Edwards syndrome.

stemEn: A neonate was found to have epicanthal folds and excessive skin at the nape of the neck, consistent with trisomy 21. Which is the most likely genetic basis?
explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن أغلب free trisomy 21 ينتج من maternal meiotic nondisjunction؛ لذلك الإجابة B.
reasoningEn: Most free trisomy 21 cases in the source are attributed to maternal meiotic error.
incorrectOptionsAr: Translocation وmosaicism يمثلان نسبة أصغر من Down syndrome. Paternal errors أقل شيوعًا حسب المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Most Down syndrome is free trisomy 21 due to meiotic nondisjunction; translocation cases require parental chromosome studies.

stemEn: An 18-year-old mother delivered a baby with Down syndrome features. Karyotype showed a translocation between chromosomes 14 and 21. What will you do next?

options.text: Since the mother is 18 years old, there is low risk for recurrence
Recurrence risk is the same as the general population

explanationAr: في translocation Down syndrome يجب عمل chromosome analysis للوالدين لتحديد هل أحدهما balanced translocation carrier؛ المصدر يعرض paternal study كأفضل خيار متاح، مع أن الشرح يوصي عمليًا بدراسة كلا الوالدين.
reasoningEn: Parental chromosome analysis is required after a Robertsonian translocation is found in the child; option A is the closest available choice.
incorrectOptionsAr: صغر سن الأم لا يلغي recurrence risk في translocation cases، ولا يمكن اعتبار الخطر مساويًا للgeneral population قبل معرفة parental carrier status.
clinicalPearl: Translocation Down syndrome changes recurrence counseling; analyze both parents whenever possible.

stemEn: A newborn has Down syndrome with a 14;21 translocation. The father's chromosome analysis is normal and the mother carries a 14;21 translocation. What is the recurrence risk?
explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن maternal carrier لRobertsonian translocation involving 14;21 لها recurrence risk تقريبًا 10–15%؛ لذلك A.
reasoningEn: The source gives a 10-15% recurrence risk when the mother carries a 14;21 Robertsonian translocation.
incorrectOptionsAr: القيم الأعلى لا تنطبق على 14;21 maternal carrier؛ 21;21 translocation هو الذي قد يصل recurrence risk فيه إلى 100%.
clinicalPearl: Recurrence risk depends on the specific Robertsonian translocation and which parent is the carrier.

stemEn: Turner syndrome most commonly occurs due to which of the following?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار paternal meiotic nondisjunction ويذكر أن فقدان الـpaternal sex chromosome يشكل غالبية liveborn 45,X cases في المراجع التي استند إليها.
reasoningEn: The source attributes most liveborn 45,X cases to a paternal-origin error/loss and keys option B.
incorrectOptionsAr: Maternal origin أقل شيوعًا في المراجع المذكورة بالمصدر، وtranslocation ليست الآلية المعتادة لـ45,X.
clinicalPearl: Turner syndrome is usually sporadic rather than inherited in a Mendelian pattern.

stemEn: A 14-year-old girl has primary amenorrhea, short stature, normal mentality and a webbed neck. What is the most likely finding on cardiac examination?

options.text: Systolic ejection murmur best heard under the left scapula

explanationAr: الـphenotype يشير إلى Turner syndrome، المرتبط بـcoarctation of the aorta وbicuspid aortic valve. Murmur في left infrascapular region يدعم coarctation؛ لذلك A.
reasoningEn: Turner syndrome is associated with coarctation, which can produce a systolic murmur heard in the left infrascapular region.
incorrectOptionsAr: Fixed split S2 يوحي ASD، loud single S2 يرتبط بآفات أخرى، وdextrocardia ليست association نموذجية لـTurner.
clinicalPearl: Turner syndrome requires cardiovascular evaluation for coarctation, bicuspid aortic valve and aortic disease.

stemEn: A 6-year-old girl is evaluated for short stature. Her length at birth was normal and she is currently on the 5th percentile. She had repair of aortic coarctation at age 3 years. What syndrome should be suspected?
explanationAr: Short stature في girl مع history of coarctation is a high-yield clue لـTurner syndrome في المصدر.
reasoningEn: The combination of female short stature and repaired coarctation strongly supports Turner syndrome in the recall.
incorrectOptionsAr: Noonan syndrome قد يسبب short stature وبعض cardiac lesions، لكن coarctation في فتاة يجعل Turner هو مفتاح المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Consider Turner syndrome in any girl with otherwise unexplained short stature, especially with left-sided cardiac disease.

stemEn: A child presented with hypertelorism, small chin, and hypogonadism. Which of the following is true regarding the suspected syndrome?

options.text: 90% of affected children are mentally retarded
The diagnosis is made by karyotyping

explanationAr: المصدر يقول إن الـfeatures غالبًا تمثل Noonan syndrome، لكنه يصرّح أن none of these choices is correct. لذلك لا نختار A أو B ولا نخترع option غير موجود.

incorrectOptionsAr: Severe intellectual disability ليست موجودة في 90% من Noonan syndrome، والتشخيص ليس routine karyotyping لأنه عادةً monogenic RAS/MAPK disorder.
clinicalPearl: When the source itself says no option is correct, preserve the recall as conflicting instead of forcing an answer.

stemEn: A karyotype was provided. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يصف الـkaryotype بأنه Klinefelter syndrome؛ الصورة الأصلية ضرورية لأن الـstem لا يحتوي cytogenetic notation نصيًا.
reasoningEn: The source keys the provided karyotype as Klinefelter syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا يمكن تقييم الصورة بدقة في الموقع قبل ربط الـoriginal karyotype asset.
clinicalPearl: Klinefelter syndrome is classically 47,XXY and often presents with tall stature, small firm testes and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism.

stemEn: A child presented with gynecomastia, small testes, tall stature, and high FSH/LH. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: Tall stature + gynecomastia + small testes + elevated FSH/LH = hypergonadotropic hypogonadism، وهو classic Klinefelter syndrome (47,XXY) في المصدر.
reasoningEn: The phenotype and gonadotropin pattern are classic for Klinefelter syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: 47,XYY لا يسبب النمط الكلاسيكي من small testes/gynecomastia. 46,XXXY صياغة cytogenetic غير متوافقة مع عدد chromosomes كما كُتبت في المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Klinefelter syndrome causes primary testicular failure with elevated gonadotropins.

stemEn: A child has clinical features of Klinefelter syndrome. This patient has a high risk for which complication?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار breast cancer. Klinefelter syndrome يرتبط أيضًا بانخفاض bone density/osteoporosis، لذلك صياغة 'high risk' بين A وB تحتاج مراجعة المقصود الامتحاني قبل النشر النهائي.
reasoningEn: The source key is breast cancer, although osteoporosis is also a recognized complication of hypogonadism in Klinefelter syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: Bleeding tendency ليست complication كلاسيكية. Osteoporosis ليست خيارًا عديم الصلة، ولذلك السؤال يحتاج verification وليس استبعاده بصمت.
clinicalPearl: Klinefelter syndrome is associated with increased male breast cancer risk and reduced bone mineral density.

stemEn: A 12-year-old boy has weight at the 75th percentile, height at the 95th percentile, and Tanner stage 1. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار hypogonadism لكنه يعترف أن age 12 with Tanner 1 لا يحقق بالضرورة formal delayed-puberty definition، ويقترح أن tall stature قد يوحي بـKlinefelter. لذلك نحفظ مفتاح المصدر ونضعه للمراجعة.
reasoningEn: The recall key is hypogonadism, but the source itself notes that the age and Tanner stage are not fully diagnostic of delayed puberty.
incorrectOptionsAr: Obesity لا يمكن إثباتها من weight percentile وحده دون BMI، وhyperthyroidism لا يفسر Tanner stage 1 بشكل مباشر.
clinicalPearl: Do not diagnose delayed puberty solely from Tanner stage 1 at age 12 in a boy; age thresholds matter.

stemEn: A pregnant woman at 13 weeks of gestation was found to have high alpha-fetoprotein (AFP). Other labs including beta-hCG and estradiol were normal. Ultrasound confirmed a singleton fetus. What is the most likely cause?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار Neural tube defect، لكن anencephaly نفسها نوع من open neural tube defect وقد ترفع AFP؛ لذلك وجود A وC معًا يجعل السؤال ambiguous بصيغته المحفوظة.
reasoningEn: The source key is the generic category 'neural tube defect', but anencephaly is itself an open neural tube defect, creating overlap among the options.
incorrectOptionsAr: Trisomy 18 و13 ترتبطان بأنماط screening مختلفة، لكن لا يمكن اعتبار C خطأ تمامًا لأنها subtype من A.
clinicalPearl: When one answer option is a subtype of another, preserve the source key but flag the item for reconstruction.

clinicalPearl: Genetic counseling indications depend on the specific reproductive/genetic risk, not a single universal age cutoff alone.
